title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover
author: Evelyn Park
description: Fixes a race in the SLO enforcer backoff queue that could cause incorrect ordering of circuit-breaker backoff timers during region failover, leading to unbalanced load shedding and brief SLO violations. This PR contains a targeted hotfix: 1) serialize backoff enqueue/dequeue operations via a lightweight sequence token instead of coarse global locks, 2) add quorum-aware timestamp propagation during regional failover to preserve backoff ordering across replicas, 3) widen a safety window in the priority queue comparator to avoid reordering on near-identical timestamps, and 4) add end-to-end smoke tests and a targeted integration test that reproduces the failover race observed in production (SUP-1023). Backport candidate for the 2026-02-14 patch release. See linked Linear items for context and the incident notes.
